R7BF-bear-backcountry-0001.name: 1.9 km W of Sikanni Chief River
R7BF-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7BF-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Burn from 2023 (fire G83130), 350 m E: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 11 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 170 m E: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 144 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.19817, -121.77162, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.2 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 7 m, about 105 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m W of the spot at 442 m (58.24519, -121.77741). Water: unnamed wetland 240 m SW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-48, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-30, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BF-bear-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-48: about 134 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
